title: THE STASH BELT NUMBERS ARE READABLE
why: Seen on the 4K stash screenshot of 2026-10-08: the key numbers in the tactical belt slots under the loadout were 10.5 pixels, a speck in a 62 pixel slot on a TV. An empty slot shows its number at 14, and a filled slot shows its key number and stack count at 12 in the corners.
now: The key numbers in the stash belt slots are easier to read.
